description: This file implements functions for managing a vector of parameter groups and their setting operations in a network management context. It handles initialization, cleanup, addition of parameters, checks for group consistency, and executing group parameter set operations via callback hooks, optimized for bulk operations.

methods.name: void GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Init(group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Initializes a group set vector structure by setting its pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Destroy(group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the group set vector, including parameter paths and error messages, and resets its fields.

methods.name: void GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Add(group_set_vector_t * gsv,char * path,char * value,bool is_required,combined_role_t * combined_role)
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the group set vector after checking existence, permissions, and type requirements; tracks errors within the vector itself.

methods.name: bool GROUP_SET_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId(group_set_vector_t * gsv,int index,int num_entries)
methods.description: Checks if a subset of parameters in the vector share the same group ID; used to enforce ownership constraints during sets.

methods.name: int GROUP_SET_VECTOR_GetFailureIndex(group_set_vector_t * gsv,int index,int num_entries)
methods.description: Finds the index of the first required parameter in a subset that failed to set, aiding in error detection.

methods.name: void GROUP_SET_VECTOR_SetValues(group_set_vector_t * gsv,int index,int num_entries)
methods.description: Performs the actual setting of parameters, either in grouped bulk calls or individually, depending on compile-time settings. Handles errors and rollback semantics accordingly.

methods.name: int SetParameterGroup(int group_id,group_set_vector_t * gsv,int_vector_t * iv,bool is_required)
